svg.title: Parallel lines SR and UW with crossing lines at V (WASSCE 2025 Q43-44)
svg.desc: Two straight lines cross at a point V, forming an X shape. One line runs from S at the upper left, through V, down to T at the lower right. The other runs from U at the lower left, through V, up to W at the upper right. A separate ray from S goes up to R, marked with a double arrow; the line from V to W is marked with a matching double arrow. At S, the angle between ray SR and the line down to V is marked 45°. At V, the angle between line VW and line VT is marked x. At T, the angle between line VT and line UT is marked 20°. At U, the angle between line UV and line UT is shown with an arc but no number.
